title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
plot_overview: A quarter-century after September 11, the attacks continue to shape lives across generations. Orphaned children, journalists covering the War on Terror, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines affected by the 2021 withdrawal share their experiences and perspectives.
will_you_like_this: You may like this if you’re interested in personal accounts of September 11’s long-lasting effects across generations; Not for you if you prefer light or purely fictional stories.
review_summary: Pros: multiple perspectives; generational scope; personal stories | Cons: heavy subject matter; broad historical focus
